LanguageData.SmarterBeds_LockDesc: Keep this bed with its owner. Nobody will try to negotiate for this room, and its owner will not negotiate for a different one. Assigning a bed yourself locks it automatically.
LanguageData.SmarterBeds_Sec_Scoring: Choosing a bed (scored in mood points)
LanguageData.SmarterBeds_Intro: Colonists pick the best free bed by how happy it would make them, and a colonist who sleeps badly can ask another colonist to swap rooms. Hover any setting for what it does. Everything here is scored in mood points, the same unit as the game's own thoughts.
LanguageData.SmarterBeds_S_Enabled_Tip: Master switch. Off, the game picks beds exactly as it normally does and nobody negotiates.
LanguageData.SmarterBeds_S_Verbose_Tip: Writes every bed score, negotiation roll and mood effect to the dev log.
LanguageData.SmarterBeds_S_RoomMood_Tip: How much the room counts. 1 uses the game's own mood for the room as it is (a mediocre bedroom +1, a mediocre barracks -4, outdoors -4).
LanguageData.SmarterBeds_S_Rest_Tip: Mood points per 1.0 of bed rest effectiveness. At 10, a bed that is 5% better is worth half a point.
LanguageData.SmarterBeds_S_Distance_Tip: Mood points lost per cell walked to the bed. Only used when choosing among free beds.
LanguageData.SmarterBeds_S_Overflow_Tip: Beds marked overflow lose this many points, so they are only used when nothing else is free.
LanguageData.SmarterBeds_S_Unmet_Tip: Applied to a title-holder for a room that is not a personal bedroom, or that fails the title's requirements. Each is -6 in the game, so this matches it.
LanguageData.SmarterBeds_S_Negotiate: Let colonists negotiate for better rooms
LanguageData.SmarterBeds_S_Negotiate_Tip: A colonist who is sleeping badly can choose, as recreation, to ask another colonist for their room.
LanguageData.SmarterBeds_S_Quality: Also negotiate for a plain upgrade
LanguageData.SmarterBeds_S_Quality_Tip: Off: colonists only negotiate to fix a royal bedroom problem or jealousy. On: a big enough upgrade is reason enough.
LanguageData.SmarterBeds_S_QualityGap_Tip: The mood gained by taking the room. 3 is, for example, a barracks bed (-4) to a decent bedroom (+2) being a 6, but a decent bedroom to a slightly better one being a 1, which is not worth the conversation.
LanguageData.SmarterBeds_S_Cooldown: Days before the same two colonists negotiate again: {0}
LanguageData.SmarterBeds_S_Cooldown_Tip: Applies to that pair only, whichever of them asks. A colonist can still negotiate with other people.
LanguageData.SmarterBeds_S_Rematch: Days before a loser may challenge the same winner: {0}
LanguageData.SmarterBeds_S_Rematch_Tip: Stops two colonists passing the same room back and forth.
LanguageData.SmarterBeds_S_MinWin_Tip: A colonist will not start a conversation they have less than this chance of winning.
LanguageData.SmarterBeds_S_JoyWeight: How often it is chosen as recreation: x{0}
LanguageData.SmarterBeds_S_JoyWeight_Tip: Multiplier on how likely a colonist who wants a better room is to spend their recreation on it.
LanguageData.SmarterBeds_S_Title_Tip: Roll points per royal title step (a Yeoman is 1 step, a Knight 3, a Baron 5). At 3, a Knight beats an equal colonist about 3 times in 4.
LanguageData.SmarterBeds_S_Defender_Tip: Added to the defender, and ties go to them. At 3, two equal colonists succeed about a third of the time when asking.
LanguageData.SmarterBeds_S_Intimidate_Tip: Intimidating uses Melee skill times this, against the defender's Melee. It is only chosen when clearly better than persuading, and never by kind colonists or against friends.
LanguageData.SmarterBeds_S_Tenure: Most points from time in the colony: {0}
LanguageData.SmarterBeds_S_Tenure_Tip: One point per 45 days, up to this. Rewards the longest-serving colonists a little.
LanguageData.SmarterBeds_S_Xp: Social experience for the asker: {0} (half on a fail)
LanguageData.SmarterBeds_S_Xp_Tip: Experience the colonist who asks gains in Social when they win a negotiation. They gain half as much when they fail.
LanguageData.SmarterBeds_S_Moods_Tip: Mood points = 0.25 x relationship + 0.25 x the mood gained from the room. The loser is bullied out (a debuff) or, if they like the winner and were persuaded, gave up the room for a friend (a buff). The winner is pleased with the new room.
LanguageData.SmarterBeds_S_Messages: Show a message when a room changes hands
LanguageData.SmarterBeds_S_Messages_Tip: A notification with the roll totals, such as "Alice talked Bob out of their bedroom. (21 vs 17)".
LanguageData.SmarterBeds_S_Log: Show negotiations in the log and speech bubbles
LanguageData.SmarterBeds_S_Log_Tip: Adds the conversation to the colonists' social log. Interaction Bubbles, if installed, shows it as speech bubbles.
LanguageData.SmarterBeds_S_AutoLock_Tip: When you assign a colonist to a bed, nobody negotiates for that room and its owner does not negotiate either. You can unlock a bed from its buttons.
LanguageData.SmarterBeds_S_Chair: Sleep in a chair when there is no bed
LanguageData.SmarterBeds_S_Chair_Tip: A colonist with no bed to use dozes off in a free indoor chair instead of on the floor. They still get a mood penalty (-3), just a smaller one than the floor (-4).
LanguageData.SmarterBeds_OverflowDesc: When enabled, colonists only claim this bed if no better free bed is available.
LanguageData.SmarterBeds_RoomWonPersuade: {0} talked {1} out of their bedroom. ({2} vs {3})
LanguageData.SmarterBeds_RoomWonIntimidate: {0} pushed {1} out of their bedroom. ({2} vs {3})
LanguageData.SmarterBeds_RoomFailed: {0} tried to take {1}'s bedroom, but {1} held firm. ({2} vs {3})
